tackle.action: a physical tackle or bite: frame 1 ready stance (the reference pose), frame 2 crouch low and pull back away from the target, frame 3 lunge the head, chest and front legs far toward the target with the mouth open to bite, frame 4 recover halfway back toward the ready stance; the feet stay on the ground

special.action: an elemental special move WITHOUT drawing the element: frame 1 ready stance (the reference pose), frame 2 plant the feet wide and draw the head back inhaling with the chest swelling, frame 3 thrust the head and neck toward the target with the mouth wide open as if blasting a beam out of it (draw NO fire, water, leaves, beam or particles), frame 4 hold the mouth open slightly less; the body stays in place

buff.action: powering up: frame 1 ready stance (the reference pose), frame 2 crouch and tense the whole body, frame 3 rear up tall with the chest puffed out and the head raised, roaring, frame 4 settle back toward the ready stance; it stays in place and keeps facing the same way

hurt.action: taking a hit: frame 1 ready stance (the reference pose), frame 2 recoil away from the attacker, the head knocked back, eyes squeezed shut and the body flinching, frame 3 recovering most of the way back toward the ready stance

species.name: 스파킷
species.design: A young fire newt starter on four legs, low and agile like a lizard: ember-orange back with darker red stripe markings, cream belly, a small crisp pixel flame (drawn with flat pixel colors and a dark outline, not glowing) at the tail tip, head raised alert.
species.palette: ember orange, dark red stripes, cream

species.name: 아쿠아링
species.design: A water axolotl starter standing on four short legs: blue body, pale belly, three feathery external gill fronds on each side of the head in coral pink, a flat paddle tail with a fin along it.

species.name: 리프링
species.design: A grass starter inspired by a sprouting acorn and a small fox: four legs, brown seed-shell cap on the head, two large leaves growing from the head like ears, green body with cream chest fur, leafy tail.

species.name: 바람삐
species.design: A small round fledgling bird standing on two sturdy legs with big three-toed feet: storm-grey wings still too small to fly, a cream-white puffed chest, a stiff sky-blue crest of three feathers swept back like a wind vane, a short pale-yellow beak, a stubby tail of two long feathers, leaning forward into the wind.

species.name: 씨앗충
species.design: A small beetle walking low on six short legs: a domed olive-green shell with ridged plates, a single sprouted seed pod with two tiny leaves growing from the top of the shell, a small brown head with two thin bent antennae and small dark eyes.
species.palette: olive green, brown, pale leaf green

species.name: 심지충
species.design: A plump larva with a soft segmented body in butter-yellow and brown bands, a short wick-like filament on its head ending in a tiny steady pixel flame drawn with flat warm colors and a dark outline (not glowing), six tiny front legs and stubby rear prolegs, curled resting posture on the ground.

species.name: 뿌리꿀
species.design: A stocky wild boar piglet low to the ground on four short legs: earthy brown bristly hide, a wide pale snout with two small blunt tusks, a ridge of three leafy sprouts along its back, a curly root-like tail, small dark eyes, heavy shoulders.

species.name: 잎귀토
species.design: The evolved form of the leafling lineage: taller and leaner, four legs, long frond-shaped leaf ears, a wider broad-leaf mantle around the neck over a cream chest, a large bushy leafy tail, the acorn-shell crest grown into a small crown; green, cream and acorn brown like its earlier stage.

species.name: 가마발
species.design: The evolved form of the sparkit newt lineage: larger, still a four-legged salamander, with heavy forelimbs ending in thick dark claws, charcoal-grey scale plates over ember-orange sides and dark red stripes, a thicker tail ending in a larger crisp pixel flame (flat colors, dark outline, not glowing), head raised.
species.palette: ember orange, charcoal grey, dark red

species.name: 뗏목랑
species.design: The evolved form of the aqualing axolotl lineage: larger and sturdier, standing on four webbed legs, a flat bark-like plate along its back like a small raft, bigger coral-pink gill fronds, blue body with pale belly, a long fin-edged paddle tail.
species.palette: blue, pale cream, coral pink, driftwood brown

species.name: 산호집
species.design: A small crab-like creature with a round rose-pink shell, small branching coral growths in two colors on top of the shell, two unequal pincers (the bigger one holds an empty clam shell), four stubby walking legs and two stalked eyes.
species.palette: rose pink, coral orange, teal, pale cream

species.name: 돌돌해마
species.design: A small sea-dragon creature that stands upright in an S-curve: soft teal body with gold salt-crystal speckles, leaf-like fin fringes on the back, a tiny frilled crest, a long snout, a prehensile tail curled tightly around a pebble, two small side fins.

species.name: 톡발도마
species.design: A small gecko clinging low on four splayed legs with big round toe pads: mustard-yellow body with a dark brown zigzag stripe along the back, white belly, two small spikes on the head, a slim tail with ridged coil-like bands, head raised and alert.

species.name: 조약양
species.design: A young mountain goat kid on four hooved legs: a cream and grey coat dappled with pebble-like patches, small curled stub horns made of layered grey stone, round stone-textured hooves, a short tail, sturdy low body, stubborn expression.

species.name: 자갈코
species.design: A stocky burrowing mole on short legs: a very large wide pale-pink snout covered in gritty speckles, tiny closed-up eyes, broad digging claws on both forelimbs, a round slate-brown body with a tuft of grey rock chips on its back.
